outcome_evidence: In base_image, the robot separates the initially nested cups (frames 38–79), arranges two cups below a third, and releases a stable three-cup pyramid (frames 117–125). It then takes down the pyramid and nests the cups together (frames 161–218), leaving a compact stack standing independently with both grippers withdrawn (frames 227–238). “Pack” is interpreted as nesting the cups together; no separate packing container is shown. No failed acquisition, topple, or unintended side effect is visible.
